import langchain

# Initialize the Langchain client
client = langchain.Client('YOUR_API_KEY')

# Define the Spotify intent
spotify_intent = client.intent('SpotifyIntent')

# Define a function to handle the "play" command
@spotify_intent.command('play', ['spotify:play'])
async def play_music(message: str):
    """Plays music on Spotify."""
    # Get the user's Spotify credentials
    credentials = await client.prompt(message.split(':')[-1])

    # Log in to the user's Spotify account
    await client.run_async(credentials.flow.login, credentials=credentials)

    # Start playing music on Spotify
    await client.run_async(credentials.flow.start_playback)

# Define a function to handle the "stop" command
@spotify_intent.command('stop', ['spotify:stop'])
async def stop_music(message: str):
    """Stops playing music on Spotify."""
    # Log in to the user's Spotify account
    await client.run_async(credentials.flow.login, credentials=credentials)

    # Stop playing music on Spotify
    await client.run_async(credentials.flow.stop_playback)
